experiment: GL T720 native-f32 versus f32-I/O/f64-internal scalar synthesis diagnostic
host: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X, 16 physical cores / 32 logical CPUs

builds.rust_f64_paired: same plus temporary feature m6-force-paired; M6_FORCE_PAIRED_F64=1 at runtime
builds.rust_profile: same plus isolated m6-legendre-profile feature; used only for one-call stage/counter data
builds.ducc_profile: separate instrumented clone/binary used only for first-call alm2leg timing and work counts

method: Three fresh-process interleaved pairs per cell. Warm reusable-plan/workspace batch medians; process startup and setup excluded. Randomized participant order per pair. f32 fixtures are from scripts/benchmark_ducc_f32_native.py; f64 inputs are exact f32-to-f64 promotions outside timing; f64 outputs are cast to f32 outside timing before comparison with DUCC.
limitation: Diagnostic only. No production source or numerical policy changed. Timed native-f32 ratios remain GAP; no acceptance claim from three pairs.
